messages:
Meera: Quick flag 1 Q3 decision needed for Search Assist rollout. We need committed infra in eu-west and us-west. Ballpark ask: EU 40 GPU-equivalents, US 30 baseline, +10 canaries/region. Can infra confirm commitability and ETA by EOD Wed? cc @David @James @Oliver

David: Current pool: ~30 EU, ~20 US free. To hit 40/30 we need to place reserve orders. Vendor lead times: optimistic 12 wks, realistic 14-16 for several SKUs. Tradeoffs: (A) move canaries to shared pool, (B) delay EU GA ~3wks, (C) cloud-burst for initial traffic. Which tradeoff do we pick?

James: 12 wks is aggressive for A100-class hardware. Customs + racking in EU could add 1-2 weeks. Suggest hybrid: reserve ~60% of EU need, cloud-burst + repurpose the rest. Also check rack space if we require additional cabinets.

Sarah: Cloud-burst path looks viable temporarily. We can wire burst-to-cloud in ~48-72h and keep p95 SLOs for premium tiers. Need runbook updates and extra egress cost monitoring for EU.

Oliver: Budget note 1 reserved 40 EU + 30 US roughly $1.2M/year (estimate). Cloud-burst is variable cost and could spike; finance needs SLO signoff to approve reserves.

Meera: Two paying customers (HealthTechA, LegalCorp) require EU data locality. If we delay EU GA they're impacted. Private deployment is possible but eats capacity. Need product prioritization guidance.

David: We can carve ~8 on-prem nodes for Private, but that reduces infra headroom for other launches. Product must choose if those customers get priority.

James: Proposal: soft-launch (internal + select partners) using cloud-burst for general traffic, then GA after reserved hardware arrives. Staged rollout reduces risk and gives procurement breathing room.

Meera: To call go/no-go we need infra feasibility against acceptance criteria: 1) sustained 24/7 throughput 200 req/s, 2) p95 latency <200ms, 3) capacity for 10 concurrent canaries/region. Target date to meet criteria: 2026-07-15 for GA. Can infra map feasibility to that date?

David: Hybrid plan feasible: reserve order for 30 EU + cloudburst covering 10 + repurpose 10 from internal pools. If we place reserve order by Monday, vendor ETA ~12-14 weeks best-case. Cloud-burst setup ~3 days. We can meet (1)-(3) for a soft-launch profile.

Oliver: Finance requests $300k downpayment approval to lock vendor pricing by Friday; otherwise vendor prices likely +8-10%.

Meera: Decision: proceed with hybrid. Action items: David -> place reserve order by Fri (owner:David); James -> verify customs buffer and update ETA by Wed (owner:James); Sarah -> implement cloud-burst config & run perf tests by next Tue (owner:Sarah); Oliver -> file finance approval ticket by Thu (owner:Oliver). I'll draft comms for HealthTechA/LegalCorp.

David: Placing order now. infra-bot: created PO #PO-8791 for vendor "AtlasCompute". Vendor ETA ~13 wks pending confirmation.

infra-bot: PO-8791 created. Vendor confirmation pending. Procurement tracker: https://procure.internal/po/8791 :package:

James: Adding a 2-week buffer for EU port congestion 1 updating tracker ETA to 15 weeks to be safe.

Meera: :thumbsup: Updating roadmap doc and pausing GA customer communications until infra confirms arrival window.

Sarah: Starting perf-test prep. I'll run this once cloud-burst is live:
```
make perf-test REGION=eu-west SCALE=50 RPS=200
```
Posting results here.

Oliver: Finance ticket FIN-2026-104 opened and marked high priority.

David: Escalating with procurement lead in case vendor delays.

Meera: Recap: hybrid procurement + cloud-burst for Q3 Search Assist GA. Owners assigned above. Next sync Thurs 10:00 AM. If any blocker pops up before Fri, ping in this thread.
